method: Three separate source-painted pots rotating about individual handle joints beneath authentic fixed rack/hook occluders. Premultiplied alpha sampling. No whole-rack motion.

actions.attack: Lead pot anticipates with a tilt; three staggered short swings answer as a kitchen rhythm, settling through a tiny final clink.
actions.hurt: Immediate alternating recoil, two diminishing rebounds, return to rest.
actions.defeat: Handles slip in sequence; each pot sinks and dissolves, leaving the stationary empty rack and hooks.

orientation.method: Reflect the complete unlettered rack and pots so bowl openings face left; staggered anticipations move right and strike swings move left after reflection. No anatomy or handed tool is mirrored. Pivot stays at the cell center.

review_limits: All decoded packing/timing checks passed and chronological poses inspected. Full-speed intended-size visual approval and game integration remain unverified.
